title: Tailscale Exit Node Data Share
app: OpenWrt, UniFi, Pi-hole, AdGuard Home, Tailscale, Cloudflare Tunnel, DNS over HTTPS resolvers, and scheduled probes via syslog, APIs, and Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=tailscale:netmap role=exit_node
| bin _time span=1d
| stats sum(tx_gb) as tx_gb, sum(rx_gb) as rx_gb by node _time
| sort - tx_gb
description: Uses Tailscale exit-node telemetry telemetry to monitor which nodes are carrying the most routed traffic in index=personal.
value: Splunk turns the feed into an operational check for exit nodes that may need more capacity or clearer policy, so the signal does not stay buried inside separate consumer apps or exports.
implementation: Ingest Tailscale exit-node telemetry data through its real API, export, MQTT bridge, or open-source connector into `index=personal`; preserve the fields referenced in the SPL and schedule the search on a hourly cadence.
visualization: Daily transfer chart for exit nodes.
grandmaExplanation: It flags which nodes are carrying the most routed traffic so you can spot exit nodes that may need more capacity or clearer policy before it becomes annoying.
